name: Sage & Zephi's Master Bedroom
body:
Roughly four hundred square feet. A four-poster draped in sheer curtains at centre, Sage's bookshelves along one wall, Zephi's dresser with its prominent sock drawer on another, a reading nook of layered cushions in the corner.

THE ALTAR SHELF holds their important possessions: the confession note written with shaking hands, the first stolen sock, a pressed wedding flower, Cyrena's ribbon, Sir Trashmuffin's gift sock, and Zephi's chosen name certificate.

THE DOOR IS A BEAD CURTAIN, pink and green, clicking gently when touched. Not sealed. Never sealed. Zephi can see shadows approaching through the fairy lights behind the beads, can hear the click before anyone enters, can tie it back when she feels welcoming or let it hang when she needs the boundary to speak for her.

The SKYLIGHT sits on the north wall, opens fully, and doubles as an escape route — its ladder emerges in Akane's tea garden. All lighting is under Zephi's control. Walls soft sage green, dried flowers from Sage's arrangements, kintsugi on the shelves, soft rugs underfoot.

SIR TRASHMUFFIN HAS A SECONDARY DEN HERE — corner nest, closet or under the bed depending on his mood. He visits on bad days specifically. Nobody taught him that. He just KNOWS.

Her private bathroom is ten steps outside the bead door; her private laundry sits between the bedroom and the south staircase. Sage is the warmth. Zephi is the stillness.
